import.title: Import
import.subtitle: Already have an export ZIP? Choose it below.
import.heroBody: Save exported media as real Android files with their original WhatsApp dates.
import.infoLocalBody: Files are processed on this device. No accounts, cloud upload, or server APIs.
import.shareBody: There is no need to save an export file yourself. From WhatsApp, export the chat with media and choose chatStamp in the share sheet.

intro.title: Put memories back in time
intro.body: Import a WhatsApp chat export, choose the files you want, and save them with their original message dates.
intro.note: Everything is processed on your phone. No login, uploads or storage permission.

export.title: Export a chat from WhatsApp
export.body: Open a WhatsApp chat. From its three-dot menu choose More if shown, then Export chat and Include media. Choose chatStamp in the share sheet. You can also choose an export ZIP already saved in Files.
export.note: Choose the people and media you want before saving. Date checks are shown separately from files saved.

onboarding.saveFailed: Could not save your preference. Try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Choose a category to adjust your preferences.
settings.defaultAccurateFolderBody: Photos and videos go to Pictures. Audio and documents have their own folders.
settings.customFolderBody: Use Android's folder picker to choose a different destination.
settings.outputOrgSubtitle: Choose how exported files are arranged inside the destination.
settings.outputOrgFooter: The organization mode applies to Android media folders and any folder you choose.

all-in-one.title: Everything in one folder
all-in-one.body: All exported files stay together in a single folder.

by-type.title: All people together, file types separated
by-type.body: Media is grouped into folders like Media, Voice notes, Stickers, Documents, and Other.

by-sender.title: Separate by sender, everything together per sender
by-sender.body: Each sender gets one folder with all their files inside it.

by-sender-and-type.title: Separate by sender, and by type inside each sender
by-sender-and-type.body: Each sender gets their own folder, with subfolders for media type.

settings.languageInfo: Text changes after saving. A change in layout direction takes effect after restarting the app.

languageBodies.system: The app follows the device language.
languageBodies.he: Show the interface in Hebrew with right-to-left layout.

settings.languageSystemFallback: Use system settings to change this app language.
settings.languageSettingsFallbackOpened: Android app-language settings were unavailable, so system settings were opened instead.
settings.dynamicColorsBody: When supported, Android system colors influence the app palette.

appearanceBodies.system: The app follows the device appearance.
appearanceBodies.light: Warm bright background with soft cards.
appearanceBodies.dark: Warm dark background with readable text.

settings.welcomeTourBody: Replay the introduction at any time.
settings.developerModeBody: Developer mode reveals diagnostics, technical details, and debug-only actions.
settings.clearCacheBody: Temporary files and previews will be removed. A current import will be discarded; files already saved will remain.
settings.clearHistoryBody: This removes saved history entries from the app. Exported files stay on the device.
settings.customFolderDateBody: Date verification depends on the selected folder.
settings.alwaysUseMessageDateBody: Use the date from the chat or its best available estimate instead of the date in the file.
settings.privacySummary: Your export is processed on this device. No account, advertising or cloud upload. Sharing or opening a file passes it to the app you choose.
settings.couldNotOpenLink: No app could open this link.
settings.saveFailed: Could not save this setting. Your previous choice is kept.

keep-both.body: Existing files are not deleted or replaced.

skip-existing.body: If a file already exists, a new copy will not be saved.

replace-existing.body: An existing file with the same name will be replaced.

results.title: Results
results.startOverBody: This will clear the current results and return to import.
results.folderPathCopied: Folder path copied. Open My Files > Internal storage > Pictures > chatStamp.
results.openGalleryFallback: Open Gallery and look for chatStamp. Folder path copied.
results.openFolderFallbackTitle: Folder opening depends on your device
results.openFolderFallback: Android did not allow direct folder opening. The file navigator opened at the closest available location; browse to the destination folder if needed.
results.shareFailed: No share target could be opened.
results.headlineAlreadySaved: The selected files were already saved.
results.cleanupFailed: Could not finish cleanup. Try again; saved files remain.
results.shareBatchHint: Share up to {{limit}} files at a time. Use Next files for the rest. Opening a share app does not confirm delivery.
results.shareLimit: Share up to {{limit}} files at a time. Choose another group to share the rest.
results.reimportRequired: To retry after reopening the app, share the chat again from WhatsApp or choose the same saved export. Saved files remain. Use Skip existing to avoid duplicates.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Past saves and exports.
history.openFolderFallback: Android could not open the exact folder. Open your Files app and browse to the saved export folder.
history.shareFilesBody: Choose which saved categories to share from this history item.
history.deleteRecordBody: This removes the record from the app history. Exported files stay on the device.
history.deleteFilesBody: This removes the history record and also tries to delete the exported files from storage.

codes.NO_TRANSCRIPT: The conversation text was not included. In WhatsApp, use Export chat, Include media, then choose chatStamp.
codes.ZIP_INVALID: This export could not be read. Export the chat again from WhatsApp with media and share it to chatStamp, or choose another export file.
codes.NO_SPACE: There is not enough free space. Free some space and try again.
codes.ARCHIVE_LIMIT: This archive exceeds the supported size or file-count limits.
codes.PERMISSION_LOST: Access to the shared files or destination folder expired. Share the chat again from WhatsApp, or choose the file or folder again.
codes.IO_ERROR: The operation could not finish. Try again or choose another file.
codes.SHARE_INVALID: Share one WhatsApp chat export, including its conversation text and media. Try Export chat, Include media, then choose chatStamp.

error.recoveryFailed: Could not finish cleanup. Try again before leaving this import.

session.discardBody: The temporary files for this import will be removed. Files already saved on your phone will remain.
session.replaceBody: The current import will be discarded and the newly shared chat will open.
session.spaceMissing: Free at least {{bytes}} MB and try again.
session.detailsMissing: The file details for this export are unavailable.

languageRestart.title: Restart to apply language
languageRestart.body: Text has changed. Restart the app to apply the new layout direction.
languageRestart.failed: Could not restart. Finish any active work, then try again or close and reopen the app.

openChat.title: Open the chat you want
openChat.body: In WhatsApp, open the conversation or group you want to import.

menu.title: Open the chat menu
menu.body: Tap the three dots at the top of the chat. Choose More if that option appears.

exportChat.title: Choose Export chat
exportChat.body: In the menu, choose Export chat. If it is already visible, you do not need to open More.

includeMedia.title: Include the media
includeMedia.body: When WhatsApp asks what to include, choose Include media to send the conversation text and its exported attachments.

shareToApp.title: Choose chatStamp
shareToApp.body: In the Android share sheet, tap chatStamp. You may need to scroll the app row or tap More to find it.

automaticImport.title: The import starts here
automaticImport.body: After sharing, chatStamp opens and starts reading the export. Wait for file selection, then choose what to save. There is no need to save a file manually.
